findings.where: connectors/telegram/src/telegram_connector/archive.py ArchiveService.search ORDER BY; tools.py Connector.search offset cursor
findings.problem: ORDER BY ts_rank DESC, sent_at DESC, message_id DESC is not a total order across chats (message_id is per chat). With equal keys in two chats, PostgreSQL top-N sort orders ties differently for different LIMIT, and the connector pages by re-querying LIMIT offset+limit+1: items are duplicated and lost across pages while complete=true. Reproduced on PG16 (page size 3: 102 returned, 93 unique)
findings.required_improvement: Add c.chat_ref as the last ORDER BY key; test: two chats with equal rank/sent_at/message_id, page through, assert every item exactly once

findings.ref: ADR-0004 'Последствия' (контрактный тест схемы ... и уведомление при обновлении), CON-TG-02/CON-TG-06
findings.problem: Both checks compare the vendored files with the same pinned commit; nothing looks at newer gxg_agents_v2 commits, so the 'notification on update' the ADR requires does not exist. A gxg_agents_v2 migration that renames a read column or changes the purge-on-scope-removal trigger leaves Hub CI green; the connector's scope boundary ('the archive holds only scope chats') rests on that trigger
findings.required_improvement: A check that fails/notifies when gxg_agents_v2 has commits after the pinned one touching supabase/migrations with telegram_archive or capability_hub.connections (e.g. check_upstream.sh --drift: git fetch; git log <pinned>..origin/main -- supabase/migrations | grep), wired into check-all/ci.yml (scheduled), or a pinned git submodule + Dependabot/Renovate gitsubmodule updates; document it in SOURCE.md

findings.problem: A scope chat granted but not yet synced has no chats row; thread/collect answer not_found and a search naming it fails entirely, where the real search returns not_synced. Fail closed, but contract and runbook ('чат вне scope') diverge
findings.required_improvement: backlog: document in README/tool description; revisit when the role may read the Connection scope

findings.where: archive.py ArchiveService.collect (wait is not None -> flood_wait)

findings.required_improvement: Record the decision in service-integration-v1 (or return the page with partial_reasons rate_limited)
